sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 6975 of 2025
Petitioner :- Ashwani Pandey

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Avinash Tiwari,Dharmendra Kumar Shukla,Vijay Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Praveen Kumar Giri,J.
1. Heard Shri Dharmendra Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the petitioner and Shri O.P. Dwivedi,
learned Aga-I for the State.

2.  This writ petition has been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 04.02.2025, in Case Crime No. 0024 of 2025, under Sections 376 and 120B IPC, Police Station Mail,
District Deoria.

3. Submission of learned counsel for the petitioner is that he has been falsely implicated in the present case, the informant was having consented physical relationship and, as such, allegations of Ashwani Pandey vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159493501/
1 rape are absolutely false.

entities.text: Ashwani Pandey vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There was no false promise of marriage and even as per the first information report there are long standing relationship between them.

4. Per contra, learned AGA-I on his instructions has pointed out that charge-sheet has already been submitted against other three accused being charge-sheet No. A15/2025 forwarded on 19.03.2025,
whereas the petitioner is the main accused and that his real brother Ashutosh Pandey was granted interim relief in Criminal Writ Petition No. 5242 of 2025 on the ground that the main allegation is against Ashwini Pandey, who is the brother of the petitioner.
5. Now in our opinion, he cannot seek parity with the co-accused who have in fact already been chargsheeted now.

6. We find substance in the argument of learned AGA and perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence and there can be no part quashing,
particularly, when the petitioner herein is the main accused.

7. Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt.
Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.
8.
